question: I think that Roswaal, who was able to make it snow over all of Sanctuary’s area, would have been able to freeze all the Great Rabbits at once and defeat them, but setting aside if he would have done that, in terms of raw power, could Roswaal defeat the Great Rabbit?
answer: On the condition that he draws the Great Rabbit into a well-prepared area, it’s possible. There’s no guarantee that none of them have gotten away, so whether he can kill all of them is a different matter. It would work if he uses Subaru as a lure.
